g.text: ❌ THE DILEMMA OF PHYSICAL PAPER MENUS
✦ Crushing Reprint Costs: Indian restaurants spend ₹45,000 to ₹95,000 every year replacing torn pages.
✦ Grease & Sauce Stains: 68% of diners notice oily thumbprints, food spills, and dog-eared corners.
✦ Inflexible Prices: Reprint delays prevent adjusting prices when seasonal mutton or tomato wholesale rates jump.
✦ Peak Rush Hour Waiting: Hungry guests wait 8 to 14 minutes just to receive a laminated physical card.
✦ Permanent 24K Table Placard: Placed once on the table, stays forever. Never reprints.
✦ Sub-500ms Instant Loading: Zero app download required; opens in mobile camera instantly.
✦ 12ms Live Cloud Sync: Toggle sold-out items or change prices in real-time from owner phone.
✦ Pure Indian Heritage Themes: Banarasi Gold, Mughal Luxe, Ivory Dining & Rajasthani Heritage.
✦ Google Reviews Integration: Collect 5-star ratings directly from happy diners while seated.
Instant Contactless Menu • Zero App Download
BRING THIS ROYAL LUXURY TO YOUR TABLES ➔
